name: opsd
description: Prepare UK payroll, manage practice clients and track HMRC submissions.

interface.shortDescription: Run payroll and submit to HMRC
interface.longDescription: Run UK payroll in chat for your business or your clients. Ask Opsd to add an employee, prepare this month’s pay or show what each employee will take home. When you’re happy with the figures, approve the submission to HMRC in your browser.
defaultPrompt: Use Opsd to help me prepare this month's payroll.
Use Opsd to show the latest payroll run for a practice client.
Use Opsd to check whether HMRC accepted my last submission.
